name: extension_status
description: Whether this extension is currently recommended for adoption (`live`) or has been removed pending a return trigger (`dormant`).

aiGuidance.purpose: Whether this extension is currently recommended for adoption (`live`) or has been removed pending a return trigger (`dormant`).
aiGuidance.extraction: `live`: the extension is recommended for adoption where it fits; populate `extension_adds` and `extension_cost_of_non_adoption`, and clear `content`. `dormant`: the extension was removed after a usage attestation found no adopters; state the removal in `content` per the existing Status / Removed surface / Return trigger convention, and leave `extension_adds` and `extension_cost_of_non_adoption` empty.
